items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: I had an opportunity to see Duke Ellington close up and to see Johnny Hodges and Sonny Greer.

ctx.x: Well I remember...I was saying that I was beginning to meet a cross section of worldly-known musicians. First we had the territorial bands, well- the local community bands and musicians like Budd Johnson and Keg Johnson and (unintelligible), and then we had the local bands and the territorial bands and then we went on the TOBA, and from the TOBA then we went to Kansas City where that I began to meet guys who really were into music and staying, whom I'd known over the years. And then we went to Chicago where I met…

Then in Detroit is where I heard for the first time Chick Webb. In Detroit. I knew the name, you know what I mean. And then I had an opportunity to see Duke Ellington close up and to see Johnny Hodges and Sonny Greer. Sonny Greer was next in line as far as popularity. Then you had Tizol. You had Tricky Sam Nanton and you had Wellman Braud and...who else did you have?
